visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video starts inside a taxi where a screen on the back of the front seat displays a driver's ID. The camera then cuts to an outdoor street scene with a long queue of people standing outside a shop named 'Food Mansion'. The main character's legs and black boots are visible as she walks towards the entrance, stepping on the metal stairs. (2) The scene transitions to the interior of a bright hair salon with gray tiled floors. A female character with long brown hair is seated in a styling chair. A blonde hair stylist wearing a pink 'Flowers' sweatshirt and a white beanie stands behind her, touching her hair and engaging in a conversation while gesturing. (3) The stylist applies a bright red liquid from a purple bowl onto the character's hair using a brush. The character is seen wearing a protective paper shield on her forehead. While her hair is being processed, she eats a bowl of beef noodles using chopsticks and later consumes jelly supplements from pink packets. (4) Close-up shots show the red dye being washed out of the hair with water in a basin. The video ends with a reveal of the character's new vibrant red hair; she is smiling, wearing a black Versace sweater and a white scarf, posing in front of a mirror with bright studio lighting. (5) The final segment shows a scrolling screen capture of an Instagram profile page for 'Holly Hair' with various hair styling posts.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A sharp, mechanical thud of a car door closing punctuates the beginning of the audio track, set against a low-frequency urban ambient hum. A fast-paced pop music track with a dominant 4/4 electronic beat and bright synth pads begins immediately, establishing a high-energy acoustic mood. (2) The sound of rhythmic, high-frequency footsteps on a hard pavement surface is clearly audible, synchronized with the camera's movement. The music remains consistent in tempo and volume, while distant, blurred background chatter suggests an outdoor public environment with a wide spectral bandwidth. (3) A metallic latch click and a slight hinge creak signal a transition into a new acoustic environment. The ambient noise floor shifts from an open outdoor street to the damped, slightly reverberant interior of a professional studio, with the music becoming slightly more focused. (4) Two distinct female voices emerge in the mix. The primary speaker has a mid-range pitch with a friendly, casual tone and moderate speech rate. The second voice, presumably the stylist, responds with an excited, higher-pitched intonation and frequent rising contours. Sparse sounds of hair tools clinking are audible. (5) The upbeat pop BGM continues as a steady rhythmic layer under the action. Distinct slurping sounds and the percussive clatter of plastic chopsticks against a container are heard repeatedly. The vocal presence decreases significantly, replaced by occasional short, high-arousal interjections and enthusiastic reactions. (6) High-frequency crinkling of thin plastic film packaging dominates the audio foreground as items are opened. This is followed by soft, wet swallowing sounds. The background music maintains its energetic 124 BPM tempo without any structural pauses or interruptions during this phase. (7) A sudden, broad-spectrum rushing sound of a pressurized water sprayer fills the entire frequency mix, effectively masking the background music. This is a short-duration but high-intensity acoustic event with a clean, liquid texture and a dense spectral distribution. (8) The rushing water sound cuts off sharply, returning the focus to the background music. The BGM swells in amplitude for the finale, emphasizing bright, airy synthesizer chords and a more upbeat rhythmic pattern. No further human speech or real-world incidental noise is detected in the mix.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To document and promote a hair dyeing experience at a specific salon (Holly Hair) while also featuring a popular local noodle shop and specific health supplements (昕顏). The video aims to share a 'day in the life' beauty journey with high engagement through food and transformation.
